view: One compact category overview per analysis and collection
x_encoding: mean_NES across significant LISA-mapped gene sets
label_encoding: Category display name; optional directional-consistency annotation
source_fields: category_id; macrogroup_id; mean_NES; mean_NES_contextual; n_genesets_mapped; n_genesets_evaluable; n_genesets_significant; has_significant_support; gsea_padj_cutoff; consistency; min_padj
interpretation_limit: A descriptive category aggregate, not a category-level statistical test; mean_NES is NA without significant support and the contextual mean is pre-threshold.

view: Significant member gene sets within one LISA category
x_encoding: NES for the source ranked list
interpretation_limit: Member-set FDR belongs to that gene set; it is not a category FDR.

view: Over-representation summary by category and direction
x_encoding: Total overlapping genes across mapped ORA gene sets
label_encoding: Direction facet and category display name
interpretation_limit: ORA and GSEA answer different questions and must not be merged.

x_encoding: display_mean_NES_A and display_mean_NES_B; significant mean when supported, contextual pre-threshold mean for the unsupported side
y_encoding: Every configured LISA category in dictionary order
colour_encoding: Category colour and A/B endpoint identity; unsupported contextual endpoint is hollow and translucent
label_encoding: A/B labels, support state and category display name
source_fields: mean_NES_A; mean_NES_B; mean_NES_contextual_A; mean_NES_contextual_B; display_mean_NES_A; display_mean_NES_B; has_significant_support_A; has_significant_support_B; n_genesets_mapped_A; n_genesets_mapped_B; n_genesets_evaluable_A; n_genesets_evaluable_B; n_genesets_significant_A; n_genesets_significant_B; gsea_padj_cutoff; delta_mean_NES
interpretation_limit: A and B retain their own heterogeneous member sets. A blank row means neither side met the configured cutoff, not zero NES. Delta is descriptive A minus B and is absent for a blank row; it is not a formal interaction unless the source model estimated one.

view: DE genes supporting one selected category
size_encoding: Not used or fixed point size
interpretation_limit: Category membership does not make a gene causal or independently validated.

x_encoding: Panel-specific DE effect or contribution score
interpretation_limit: A prioritisation display, not a new inferential gene test.

x_encoding: Side-specific DE effect or contribution score
interpretation_limit: Profile geometry alone does not establish rescue, synergy or mechanism.

colour_encoding: Values from the user-supplied transformed matrix, optionally row-scaled
source_fields: matrix value; sample order; gene symbol; category_id
interpretation_limit: Shows the supplied expression scale; it is not an independent differential-expression analysis.

x_encoding: A and B sides or their declared samples
colour_encoding: Side-specific evidence value encoded in the source table
source_fields: label_A; label_B; category_id; symbol; plotted value
interpretation_limit: Visual pairing is descriptive and does not create a formal interaction test.

size_encoding: Degree or evidence magnitude where encoded
interpretation_limit: Layout distance and topology are not causal direction or independent replication.

colour_encoding: Blue-white-red mapping of source DE log2FC; grey for unavailable values
source_fields: kegg_id; node; symbol; log2FC; padj; retrieval metadata
interpretation_limit: A painted map does not establish pathway activation, inhibition or flux.

x_encoding: Native KEGG map coordinate or A/B panel
colour_encoding: Side-specific source DE log2FC using the recorded scale
source_fields: kegg_id; side; symbol; log2FC; padj; retrieval metadata
interpretation_limit: A/B colour differences are not a formal interaction unless the input model provides one.
